text: 380 kV GIS protection: busbar differential (87B) with breaker failure (50BF) and bay units; line protection with line differential (87L), distance (21), directional earth fault, synchro-check and auto-reclose as required by the TSO; overall clearing time (fault to arc extinction) of 100 ms or less for the 380 kV system, breaker-failure backup within 250 ms. TSO requirements of the Grid Code prevail.
